justification.C1_raw_data_stays_local: E0 pools raw interaction records on the server (1). All federated variants keep records on the client and transmit only model updates (5). This criterion describes data flow, not legal compliance.
justification.C2_update_confidentiality_vs_server: E0/E1/E2: the server receives plaintext data or plaintext updates (1; E2 adds noise only after aggregation). E3/E3-TopK/E4: the server receives CKKS ciphertexts and holds no secret key (4, not 5: confidentiality is conditional on RLWE hardness, on the server not colluding with the key holder, and the aggregate is still revealed to the key holder; Top-K additionally reveals the shared coordinate set, which the server chooses).
justification.C3_formal_output_privacy: Derived from the accountant: 1 without DP; with DP, 5 if epsilon <= 1, 4 if <= 3, 3 if <= 8, 2 otherwise (client-level, delta = 1e-5).
justification.C4_ranking_utility: Derived: linear map of risk-adjusted utility, the lower end of the 95% interval of mean nDCG@10 over seeds, from the random ranking's mean (1) to the pre-cutoff popularity ranking's mean (5). Using the lower bound prevents high between-seed variance under DP noise from scoring as utility.
justification.C5_monthly_cost: Derived: operator monthly cost mapped on a log scale from the cheapest (5) to the most expensive (1) configuration.
justification.C6_explanation_fidelity: Derived: linear map of the SHAP-minus-random removal-curve AUC gap (conditional replacement) from its minimum (1) to its maximum (5). E3 Top-10% takes E3's value because explanations were not computed for Top-k runs.
justification.C7_operational_simplicity: Components to operate beyond plaintext FedAvg: E0 none for federation (5); E1 federation only (4); E2 adds noise calibration and an accountant (3); E3/E3-TopK add key generation, custody and context distribution, and for Top-K a mask protocol (2); E4 adds both (1).
